scope.summary: Implement StudioVariable (hsk.studio.variable@1) as the single design-token primitive with the normative four-type set: Color (value carrying an explicit StudioColorProfile ref), Number (typed numeric with unit), String (text), Boolean (true/false). Every variable resolves to exactly one value per active mode of its owning collection (MT-347). There is no separate prototype-only variable type; the same primitive is shared with 14.11 (MT-383).
expected_tests: live: all four variable types round-trip through authority; each resolves one value per active mode
acceptance_criteria_original: StudioVariable with color/number/string/boolean types; one value per active mode; shared with prototyping

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-022] `StudioVariable` (schema id `hsk.studio.variable@1`) is the single design-token primitive. Its type set is normative and enumerated below. Every variable resolves to exactly one value per active mode of its owning collection ([STU-DS-023]). | Variable type | Anchor | Value domain | Primary bind surfaces | |---|---|---|---| | Color | [STU-DS-022a] | a color value carrying an explicit `StudioColorProfile` ref ([STU-DOC-003]) | fills, strokes, paint slots | | Number | [STU-DS-022b] | a typed numeric with unit | dimensions, gaps, padding, corner radius, min/max, typographic numerics, prototype arithmetic | | String | [STU-DS-022c] | a text value | text content, font-family names, variant-property values, prototype concatenation | | Boolean | [STU-DS-022d] | true/false | layer visibility, boolean component properties, prototype conditionals |
| Color | [STU-DS-022a] | a color value carrying an explicit `StudioColorProfile` ref ([STU-DOC-003]) | fills, strokes, paint slots |
| Number | [STU-DS-022b] | a typed numeric with unit | dimensions, gaps, padding, corner radius, min/max, typographic numerics, prototype arithmetic |
| String | [STU-DS-022c] | a text value | text content, font-family names, variant-property values, prototype concatenation |
| Boolean | [STU-DS-022d] | true/false | layer visibility, boolean component properties, prototype conditionals |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
